front: State both forms of the expansion of (x + y)3 and (x - y)3.
back:
• (x + y)3 = x3 + y3 + 3xy(x + y) = x3 + 3x2y + 3xy2 + y3
• (x - y)3 = x3 - y3 - 3xy(x - y) = x3 - 3x2y + 3xy2 - y3
note: Notice the alternating signs in (x - y)^3: +, -, +, -.

front: What are the factorized forms of x3 + y3 and x3 - y3?
back:
• x3 + y3 = (x + y)(x2 - xy + y2)
• x3 - y3 = (x - y)(x2 + xy + y2)
note: Remember: middle term has the OPPOSITE sign of the first binomial!

front: What does x3 + y3 + z3 equal if x + y + z = 0?
back:
If x + y + z = 0, then:
x3 + y3 + z3 = 3xyz
note: Extremely popular CBSE exam question for rapid evaluation without cubing.
